test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I often feel I am an ______, that I would be more at home at the turn of the century than today.
solution: The correct answer is **"anachronism."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Anachronism"** means something or someone that is out of place in a particular time period. (पुरातनपंथी व्‍यक्ति या व्‍यवहार जो वर्तमान में अजीब लगे) • **Example**: *Wearing a top hat and monocle to a modern-day office would be an **anachronism**__.* • The speaker feels like they don't belong in the present day and would fit in better in the past. • The correct answer is Option 1. **Correct sentence**: *I often feel I am an __**anachronism**__, that I would be more at home at the turn of the century than today.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "analogous,"** means similar or comparable. (आंशिक रूप से समरूप; अनुरूप; जिसकी तुलना की जा सके) • **Option 3, "apathy,"** means a lack of interest or emotion. (उदासीनता, अनिच्‍छा) • **Option 4, "avarice,"** means greed or a strong desire for wealth. (अत्‍यधिक धन-लोलुप) 21a:Td0c, The correct answer is **"Epitaph."**
